title: FTM - HVAC Professional
description:
Operate, inspect and maintain HVAC systems, including air-conditioning and ventilation equipment. Perform routine preventive maintenance and basic troubleshooting of system faults. Check operating readings, filters, belts and other components and record observations. Coordinate repairs and escalate major breakdowns to the responsible engineer. Follow electrical, refrigerant-handling, permit-to-work and workplace safety procedures.
